identity_lock: Edit the provided reference image as the same individual pet. Preserve the same face structure, eye placement, body proportions, fur silhouette, tail root, recognizable expression, elemental lineage cues and established markings. Do not reinterpret it as a new character.
base_style: Premium soft Mythic Elemental Chibi game character art. Very cute infant proportions, slightly oversized rounded head, compact body, short legs, large glossy expressive eyes, plush soft layered fur, refined semi-3D painterly rendering, gentle studio lighting, clean readable silhouette, subtle magical atmosphere and polished mobile-game mascot quality. Keep magical effects elegant, localized and restrained rather than covering the whole body.
preserve_rule: Keep every established feature that is not explicitly named in CHANGE ONLY unchanged. Do not redesign unrelated anatomy, pose family, camera angle, face identity, base fur structure, elemental lineage cue or existing mutation details.
negative_prompt: different character, identity drift, changed face, changed camera angle, changed pose family, unrelated redesign, photorealistic animal, realistic adult cat proportions, horror, grotesque, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, extra ears, duplicate tail, giant wings, heavy armor, busy accessories, excessive particles, galaxy texture covering the body, starfield fur, noisy pattern, muddy colors, text, logo, watermark
